title: Farm Flapper
shortDescription: Flap, shoot eggs at farm pests, ride mounts, deliver eggs to the farmer, and climb the leaderboard.
longDescription:
Defend the farm in this portrait arcade flap game.

Tap to flap. Shoot eggs at mice, crows, cats, foxes, and bulls. Grab coins, clovers, and extra lives. Ride farm mounts. Land eggs in the farmer's basket to multiply your final score.

• Fast portrait arcade loop — learn in seconds
• Combos, mounts, clovers, and extra lives
• Animated score tally at the end of every run
• Personal bests plus optional online / Instant Games leaderboard
• Challenge friends with one-tap share
• Instant play — Zero Permissions

Apex Arcade Studio. One more run.
